cupboard-hinges-drawer-runners-repair-gu.beforeTitle: Cabinet & Drawer Repairs in Perth: Hinges or Runners?
cupboard-hinges-drawer-runners-repair-gu.bodyHtml:
Before attempting repairs

This guide helps you describe a fault and plan an assessment. It does not diagnose your property or replace task-specific safety and trade requirements.

Cupboard hinge pulled out: check the panel as well as the hinge

A hinge can be sound while its screws no longer hold in a damaged cabinet panel. Conversely, a worn hinge may need compatible replacement hardware even where the panel is intact. Note whether the door has dropped, a hinge is broken or screws have pulled out. Repeatedly tightening a loose screw does not establish that the fixing area can support the door. If the door is hanging unevenly, stop using it until it can be assessed safely.

Cabinet door alignment and matching hardware

A gap or rubbing edge can involve hinge adjustment, loose mounting plates or movement in the cabinet. The hinge type, opening angle and existing mounting arrangement matter when selecting a replacement. Keep the old hardware available and record which doors are affected. Repair assessment should include neighbouring panels and the closing action, not just the visible gap. A new fitted cabinet is a different project from retaining a door and repairing its hardware.

Drawer off its runners: identify what has moved

A sticking drawer may have damaged runners, loose screws, an obstruction or distortion in the drawer box. Soft-close runners are not interchangeable simply because they look similar. Width, length, load requirements and the mounting arrangement affect compatibility. Empty an unstable drawer and avoid forcing it. Explain whether the problem began after loading, moving furniture or previous work so the assessment can consider the surrounding cabinet.

What to include in a cabinet repair enquiry

List the doors and drawers affected, what they do when used and whether you want the existing cabinetry retained. Photos of the front and safely accessible hardware can help, but are optional. Include missing parts and any rental approval requirements. A useful quote identifies hardware, fixing-area repair, alignment and any finish work. Ask what changes if hidden panel damage is found before additional work proceeds.

Common Repair Questions

Why do cupboard hinge screws keep coming loose?

The fixing hole, panel or mounting plate may be damaged, or the door load may be affecting the fixing. Repeated tightening does not identify the cause. An assessment checks both the hardware and the material holding it.

Can new drawer runners fit an older cabinet?

Sometimes, but dimensions, clearances and the mounting arrangement must match. The drawer box and cabinet condition also matter. A compatible product should be confirmed before replacement is agreed.

Should I replace the hinge or repair the cabinet panel?

That depends on which part has failed. A sound hinge in a damaged panel needs a different repair from a broken hinge on sound cabinetry. Ellis checks both before quoting.

Cupboard Hinge Repairs, Drawer Runners & Wardrobe Tracks

Can a broken kitchen cabinet hinge be replaced?

Yes. Ellis checks the hinge type, mounting holes and cabinet panel before quoting the repair. A compatible new hinge may be needed, or the damaged fixing area may require repair. Reusing the same stripped holes without assessing the panel can leave the door loose again.

Can you assess a wardrobe door scraping its bottom track?

Yes. Tell us whether it is a sliding door, whether it has come off the track and what catches. We inspect the rollers, guides, track and alignment before agreeing the repair. Do not force or lift a heavy or mirrored door that is unstable.

View Cupboard Hinge Repairs, Drawer Runners & Wardrobe Tracks

  • New cabinetry and fitted storage
  • Cabinet hinge repair example
  • cabinet and wardrobe repairs

Discuss the fault with Ellis Perth →

Cabinet repair or new cabinetry?

For existing hinges, drawer runners and wardrobe tracks, start with cupboard and wardrobe repair assessment. New fitted cabinetry is a separate design and replacement task.

Use cabinet and wardrobe repairs for an existing hinge, drawer runner or wardrobe door fitting. The Southern Corridor drawer example shows before and after views of confirmed runner replacement; it does not document an intermediate repair stage.

home-repair-priorities.beforeTitle: Home Maintenance in Perth: Which Repairs Come First?
home-repair-priorities.bodyHtml:
Scope note

This guide is for general reference only. Actual conditions vary. Contact Ellis Services Group to arrange an on-site assessment by the appropriate trade professional.

Home Safety Maintenance: Identify Immediate Hazards

Start with anything that could harm a person or rapidly damage the property. Examples may include a gas smell, sparking, active water near electricity, a ceiling that appears unstable, a broken external lock or significant storm damage. Keep people clear, isolate utilities only if you know how to do so safely, and contact the appropriate emergency service, utility or qualified trade.

Contact the Ellis Perth office when it is safe to arrange assessment and repairs. Explain any remaining hazard and confirm the visit details.

House Repairs: Active Damage Before Cosmetic Work

After immediate safety, address problems that are allowing damage to spread: ongoing leaks, failed weather seals, blocked drainage, pest entry points or openings that expose the home to rain. The visible symptom may have more than one cause, so avoid covering it cosmetically before the source is understood.

Next, consider essential daily function and security. A failed toilet in a one-bathroom home has a different priority from a stiff cupboard hinge. Heating, cooling and hot-water priorities also depend on weather and household needs. Tell Ellis if a household member needs priority assistance or if stairs, locked gates or occupied rooms affect access. Only share personal information needed to arrange the visit.

Combine Small Repair Jobs into a Home Maintenance List

Cosmetic patches, adjustments and minor installations can often be planned together when they suit the same skill set and access. Create a room-by-room list and mark each item as urgent, soon or planned. List a door that will not close, loose shelf or unstable handrail by its functional concern; a wall mark before sale photography is a separate presentation task. Record the location, preferred outcome and person approving each item. Keep electrical, plumbing and structural work in their appropriate scopes, and do not delay investigation of moisture or structural symptoms.

Contact Ellis Services Group with your Perth suburb and priority repair list. Our team arranges an on-site assessment, identifies the cause and confirms the repair plan, quote and appointment. Our own appropriately licensed personnel complete regulated work within the agreed scope.

Review the list after each visit. Close completed items, retain evidence for work that may recur and move newly identified tasks into the right priority band. If a temporary measure was used, record its limits and the required follow-up rather than allowing it to become an undocumented permanent repair.

Use the door and window repair guide for moving fittings, the shower repair guide for surface versus deeper leak concerns, and handyman repair scopes for compatible small jobs.

Home Repair Priority Questions

Is an online request suitable for an emergency?

Do not assume so. Use the appropriate emergency service or utility for immediate danger, then arrange repairs when the site is safe.

Should I patch water damage straight away?

First identify and stop the moisture source. A cosmetic patch can hide continuing damage.

Can I bundle small jobs?

Often, if the tasks suit the same capability and access. List them separately; Ellis assesses the work on site and confirms the combined scope, qualified service arrangements and written quote.

Pre-sale Repair Checklists & Cosmetic House Repairs

Which minor repairs should I quote before selling a Perth home?

Start with faults affecting use, such as doors that will not close, loose fittings and damaged trim, then discuss the required finish. Ellis can assess the repair list before photography or an open home. Underlying defects should be identified, not concealed by cosmetic work.

Can you assess doors, skirting and wall marks before real-estate photography?

Yes. Explain the deadline and which items you want retained, repaired or refinished. We inspect the faults and agree the scope and appointment with you. Cosmetic preparation is not a promise of a sale price, faster sale or a defect-free inspection.

View Pre-sale Repair Checklists & Cosmetic House Repairs

Which faults should not wait for a handyman appointment?

Immediate danger involving fire, electricity, gas, collapse or rapidly spreading water needs the appropriate emergency response. Keep clear and describe the hazard from safety. A routine repair enquiry does not replace emergency assistance.

Does an emergency handyman replace an emergency electrician or plumber?

No. The hazard determines which response and qualifications are needed. Use emergency services for immediate danger. Ellis confirms the appropriate own-team scope and appointment directly; an urgent general enquiry is not a specialist booking.

Describe a maintenance request →

Related repair decisions

Requested deadlines and immediate hazards

For same-day, weekend or urgent repair requests, describe the fault, suburb, access and preferred time. Ellis confirms the accepted appointment directly; a requested day or a website enquiry does not reserve a slot.

A deadline this week, Saturday or before an inspection needs direct confirmation of suitable personnel and parts. A half-day request or urgent label does not establish job duration, a guaranteed arrival or a completed repair by that deadline.

A stuck room door before guests arrive and repairs requested before tomorrow’s rental inspection can have different urgency. Mention whether anyone is trapped, an exit is obstructed or the item is unstable so the correct response is identified.

how-to-find-the-right-home-repairer.beforeTitle: How to Choose a Handyman in Perth for Home Repairs
how-to-find-the-right-home-repairer.bodyHtml:
Scope note

This guide is for general reference only. Actual conditions vary. Contact Ellis Services Group to arrange an on-site assessment by the appropriate trade professional.

Describe Your Small Home Repair Jobs in Perth

You do not need to diagnose a fault before asking for help. Describe what you can see, hear or smell, where it happens and when it began. “The bedroom door scrapes the floor after rain” is more useful than guessing the repair method.

Mention whether the issue is worsening, affecting another room or creating a safety concern. Include the property type, access restrictions and previous related work if known. Photos and approximate measurements are optional; Ellis checks the affected area on site.

Handyman or Licensed Trade: Match the Repair Scope

Cupboard hinges, flat-pack assembly and picture hanging are examples of small handyman repair tasks. A new power point, persistent shower leak or unstable roof component needs its own assessment and work scope.

Ask who will complete each task and what credentials apply. Our own appropriately licensed personnel complete regulated work within the agreed scope. The licensed-work guide explains how to check task-specific credentials. For a mixed list, identify work that depends on another repair being completed first.

Hiring a Handyman in Perth: Scope, Quote & Booking

Compare the scope, materials, exclusions, access assumptions and pricing basis as well as the total. Ask whether a figure is an estimate, assessment charge or written repair quote. Confirm any attendance or inspection charges before agreeing the visit.

Ellis confirms the attending team, assessment purpose and access arrangements directly. After checking the property, we confirm the repair plan and written quote. Keep the accepted scope and identify who can approve a variation if the findings change; a request or preferred date does not itself confirm a booking.

Choosing the Right Home Repairer: Common Questions

Do I need to know which trade I need?

No. Describe the symptoms and location clearly. Ellis can review the request, but the suitable service and Ellis Perth team still need to be confirmed.

Should I choose only on price?

Compare like-for-like scope, inclusions, exclusions, materials, credentials and communication as well as the total.

Who will attend an Ellis repair assessment?

Ellis confirms the attending team before the assessment. Everyday repairs are handled by our local handyman and maintenance team; regulated work is completed by our own appropriately licensed personnel for the agreed task.

Local Handyman Services & Small Repair Jobs

Can a handyman in Perth take on small home repairs?

Yes. Ellis assesses minor repairs, assembly and fittings as a single job list. Include the items that no longer work, your Perth suburb and any deadline. We confirm the suitable work, access and quote directly with you.

Can you help with a sticking door before guests arrive?

Call Ellis and explain which door is affected and when you need it working. We check the hinges, frame and clearance rather than assume a new door is needed. Urgent attendance can be arranged from 30 minutes, subject to location, safe access and circumstances outside our control; confirm the visit time with our team.

View Perth handyman services

What work suits an ordinary handyman visit?

Defined minor repairs, assembly and suitable fittings can suit a handyman visit. Tell Ellis what is faulty and what you want changed. Regulated and safety-critical work requires a separate assessment and the appropriately qualified Ellis personnel.

When should I request a licensed trade rather than a small repair?

Tell Ellis if the fault involves fixed wiring, water services, gas, structural movement or safety equipment. These require their own assessment and appropriate qualifications. Our own licensed personnel handle regulated work within the agreed scope.

Describe a maintenance request →

Related repair decisions

Choosing the right help for small repairs

Ordinary household repairs include loose fittings, furniture assembly, suitable wall mounting and minor patching. Describe the faulty item and desired result so Ellis can distinguish small repairs from a larger building or specialist task.

When comparing repairers, check the business identity, the proposed repair scope and who will perform any regulated work. A clear written quote is more useful than a broad claim that one person can fix everything.

A unit with a list of hinges, shelves and wall marks needs each fault recorded separately. Ellis checks the property, materials, permission and access before agreeing which jobs can be grouped.

photos-and-clear-scope-for-home-repairs.beforeTitle: Perth Home Repair Quotes: Photos & a Clear Repair Scope
photos-and-clear-scope-for-home-repairs.bodyHtml:
Scope note

This guide is for general reference only. Actual conditions vary. Contact Ellis Services Group to arrange an on-site assessment by the appropriate trade professional.

Photograph the damaged area, close-up details and access

If you choose to send photos, a useful set includes a wide view showing where the issue sits in the room or exterior, a closer view of the damage or fitting, and an access view showing nearby obstacles. Add a ruler or common object for scale only when it is safe. Photograph labels or model numbers if they are visible without removing covers.

Do not climb onto roofs, open electrical equipment, enter unsafe ceiling spaces or disturb suspected hazardous material to obtain an image. A photo is meant to support triage, not replace a safe inspection. If water, electricity, gas, structural movement or another immediate hazard is present, keep people away and seek appropriate urgent advice.

Describe Small Repair Jobs for a Clear Handyman Quote

Write a short description, with or without images: what is wrong, where it is, the desired outcome, how many items are affected and any known history. Separate required work from optional work. For example, ‘required: rehang one sticking internal door; optional: replace three handles if compatible’ is clearer than ‘fix doors’.

List known materials, finishes and dimensions, but mark estimates as approximate. Note whether matching an existing finish matters and whether materials are needed. Identify supplied product models, missing parts and existing repair notes, and agree any completion photos or handover record needed before booking. If the cause is unknown, say so. Our Perth team arranges an on-site assessment, checks the affected area and confirms the repair plan, written quote and any qualified service arrangements.

Confirm Changes to the Handyman Repair Scope

Conditions discovered on site can change a repair. Ask Ellis Perth team to explain the new finding, proposed work, price and schedule effect before continuing. Record the agreed variation in writing and keep any updated photos with the job record. This protects clarity without assuming that every unexpected condition is avoidable.

Send your Perth suburb and job details to Ellis Services Group. You may include safe existing photos if you wish. We arrange an on-site assessment, check the affected area, identify the cause and confirm the repair plan and quote. Your appointment details include the attending team and any qualified service arrangements required for licensed work.

Label files with the room, item and date so they remain useful later. Avoid including people, private documents, vehicle plates or unrelated belongings. If an occupant supplied the image, use it only for the maintenance purpose and share it only with the people who need it to assess or deliver the job.

Compare your list with the handyman repair scopes, then use the quote preparation guide to record inclusions, supplied parts and approvals.

Home Repair Photos and Scope: Common Questions

How many photos should I send?

If you already have photos, include a wider view of the damaged area, a close-up of the fault and access to the work area. Photos are optional; there is no minimum number.

Can photos replace an inspection?

Contact Ellis to arrange an on-site assessment. We check measurements, access, concealed-condition concerns and licensed-work requirements, then confirm the repair scope and quote.

What if the scope changes on site?

Pause, ask for the reason and document the revised work, cost and timing before authorising it.

TV Brackets, Heavy Mirror Mounting & Wall Shelving

Can a handyman wall mount a TV using an existing power point?

Ellis can assess bracket fitting where an existing power point is available. The TV, bracket, wall construction and fixing support must be compatible. New power points or changes to fixed electrical wiring are separate electrical work and should be included as a distinct requirement.

Can you mount a large TV on plasterboard in a rental apartment?

We first check the wall, support, product weight and bracket requirements; plasterboard alone is not an assurance of a suitable fixing. Confirm rental approval and the intended location. Tell us if new electrical work is required so it is not confused with bracket installation.

View TV Brackets, Heavy Mirror Mounting & Wall Shelving

Loose Curtain Rod Brackets & Roller Blind Fitting

Can someone install blinds I have already purchased in Perth?

Yes. Tell Ellis the blind type, number of windows, product measurements and supplied brackets. We check the opening, clearance and mounting surface before confirming fitting. Fixed electrical connections for motorised blinds are separate from ordinary bracket installation.

Can you repair a curtain rod pulled out of plasterboard?

Yes. We inspect the fixing holes, wall support and rod weight before agreeing the repair. Replacing a screw in the same damaged hole may not solve the problem. Include the curtain and rod details so the mounting can be assessed together.

View Loose Curtain Rod Brackets & Roller Blind Fitting

Loose Towel Rails & Bathroom Accessory Fixings

Who can fix a towel rail pulling out of the wall?

Ellis can assess a towel rail that pulls out, including the bracket, fixing holes and wall material. On tiled surfaces, concealed services and waterproofing need consideration before drilling. A towel rail is not a substitute for a correctly specified and supported grab rail.

Can you repair a bathroom shelf pulled off a tiled wall?

Yes. Tell us whether the tiles or brackets are damaged and whether water is appearing behind the fitting. We inspect the surface and support before agreeing new fixings. Recurring damp or loose tiles may need more investigation than replacing the shelf.

View Loose Towel Rails & Bathroom Accessory Fixings

Describe a maintenance request →

Describe shelves, mirrors and pictures

For shelf installation, mirror mounting or picture hanging, describe the item, intended position and what a shelf will hold. Product instructions and optional dimensions help the assessment; the supporting wall still needs checking. See the Cockburn shelf example for the visible installation sequence.

prepare-before-home-repair-quote.beforeTitle: Handyman Quotes in Perth: Prepare Your Home Repair List
prepare-before-home-repair-quote.bodyHtml:
Scope note

This guide is for general reference only. Actual conditions vary. Contact Ellis Services Group to arrange an on-site assessment by the appropriate trade professional.

Prepare a Home Repair List for Your Handyman Quote

List the affected item, location, current condition and outcome you want. Note quantities, recurring faults and previous work if known. Photos and approximate measurements are optional; a description is enough to begin arranging an assessment.

Include the suburb or postcode, property type, access contact, parking, stairs, gates and pets where relevant. Mark a preferred date as a preference until Ellis confirms it. If supplying materials, identify product models, quantities and any missing hardware without buying further parts before suitability is checked.

Handyman Cost: Hourly, Half-day & Full-day Bookings

Handyman cost in Perth depends on the agreed repair list and how the booking is priced. The existing Ellis handyman service price range provides the published hourly, half-day and full-day labour guide; it is not a final quote or a promise that every task fits one block. Ellis confirms the hours or booking block and written scope after on-site assessment.

Ask what the agreed hours cover: preparation, fitting, cleanup and any agreed material collection. Confirm the duration and any minimum or attendance charge rather than assuming that a half-day or full-day label has a fixed number of included hours. Extra time and newly found work need their price and approval agreed before proceeding.

What about materials and supplied parts?

Separate labour from materials, equipment, removal and disposal, and confirm whether product supply is included. Customer-supplied parts still need compatibility checks; missing fixings or unsuitable products can change the scope. Regulated electrical, plumbing or other specialist work is itemised separately and completed by Ellis's own appropriately licensed personnel.

Will grouping repairs guarantee a lower price?

No discount is assumed. Bring a prioritised list so Ellis can assess which jobs suit the same visit. Compare quotes for the same hours, tasks, finish and material responsibility. For a managed property, use the approval and access checklist before confirming a booking.

Compare Handyman Rates, Scope & Inclusions

Compare the same repair list, materials and desired outcome. If you choose to share photos, use the same safe existing images and notes for each comparison. The optional-photo and scope guide explains useful framing and privacy.

Ask whether labour is charged by time or by the job and whether minimum, attendance or assessment charges apply. The written proposal should distinguish supplied items, labour, materials, equipment, preparation, removal, disposal, GST treatment where applicable, exclusions and separate trade work. See the handyman scope and price guide as a starting point; the quote follows assessment.

Bundling compatible repairs may reduce repeated setup, but does not guarantee a discount. Ask how newly discovered damage will change the work, price and timing. Approve the written variation before additional repairs proceed.

What Ellis needs for initial review

Share your location, repair list and the person arranging access. Ellis confirms the assessment appointment, checks the property and explains the repair plan and written quote. Confirm the visit purpose and any agreed assessment charge before booking.

Keep the initial brief, accepted scope and approval contact together. For a managed property, distinguish permission to assess from permission to repair. If a comparison assumes a different material or work scope, clarify it before comparing the totals.

Home Repair Quote Preparation: Common Questions

Can I get a final price from photos?

Photos are optional and do not establish a final repair price. Ellis checks the affected area, measurements and access on site, then confirms the repair plan and written quote.

What should a written scope include?

The task, location, quantities, materials, inclusions, exclusions, access assumptions and how variations will be approved.

Does Ellis provide instant online quotes?

Ellis confirms your assessment appointment directly. Send the service needed and Perth postcode so our team can arrange the visit, check the job and confirm the quote.

Flat-pack Furniture Assembly & Wardrobe Assembly

How much does flat pack furniture assembly cost in Perth?

The quote depends on the item type, quantity, assembly instructions, supplied parts and any anchoring required. Tell Ellis the product model and where it will be assembled. We separate furniture assembly from kitchen fitting, modifications and electrical work.

Can you assemble a bed and desk after I move house?

Yes. Tell us the number of items, product models and whether they are new kits or partly dismantled furniture. Keep instructions and supplied hardware together if available. We check room access, missing parts and assembly requirements before confirming the quote.

View Flat-pack Furniture Assembly & Wardrobe Assembly

Itemised Handyman Quotes & Minimum-charge Questions

How much does a handyman cost in Perth?

The cost depends on the agreed task, materials, access and any separate trade work. Ellis provides a written quote after assessment. Ask us to confirm whether the work is priced by time or by the job and whether attendance, assessment or minimum charges apply before approval.

Can I request a labour-only quote using materials I supply?

Yes. Tell Ellis exactly what you will supply, including product models and quantities. We check whether the parts suit the job and identify any missing materials. The written scope should distinguish supplied items, labour, disposal and any additional charges before work starts.

View booking details

Is grouping small repairs always cheaper?

It may reduce repeated setup when the tasks and access suit each other. Materials, different trades or return stages can change the quote. Ellis confirms the charging basis and included work; no automatic bundle discount is assumed.

What should I include in my repair list?

List each faulty item by room, what happens, how many are affected and your preferred result. Include priorities, suburb, access and approval details plus supplied-product information. Photos and measurements are optional.

What should a handyman quote include?

Look for the agreed tasks, labour basis, materials, supply, access, removal, disposal and exclusions, plus the approval process for changes. Ask about any minimum or visit charge before booking. Ellis confirms the written quote after assessment.

How can I check the business and relevant qualifications?

Confirm the business identity and ask who will carry out each regulated task, with the applicable licence or registration details for that scope. A business name alone proves no trade qualification. Ellis identifies its own appropriate personnel during assessment.

Describe a maintenance request →

Preparing for flat-pack assembly

For furniture assembly, tell Ellis the product model, quantity and where the packs are located. Keep the instructions and supplied hardware together, and flag missing parts, wall anchoring or packaging removal so the quote covers the intended job.

Related repair decisions

Grouping jobs without losing the detail

Several compatible small repairs can be assessed together. A room-by-room list helps organise cupboard adjustments, wall patching, assembly and hanging work without treating different materials or methods as one identical job.

Ask for the included tasks, materials and charging basis in writing. Shared access and preparation may reduce repeated setup, but grouping jobs does not establish a discount, minimum charge or a promise that everything fits one visit.

For hinges, shelves and a wall patch in the same home, mark the priority and quantity of each item. A requested half-day is a preference to discuss; parts, drying stages and specialist work may affect the agreed booking.

Compare the full quote and verify the relevant trade

Handyman rates and booking-block price ranges describe a charging basis, not the final cost of an unassessed repair. Ellis provides the written job quote after checking the property, tasks, materials and access.

Ask whether work is charged by time or an agreed scope, and clarify minimum charges, any assessment or visit charge, materials and disposal before booking. No free visit, automatic discount or cheapest-price claim is assumed; compare equivalent inclusions.

For three small repairs or labour-only work using your supplied products, list each item and supply responsibility. Compatibility, missing parts, preparation and return stages can change the scope. Additional work needs its price and approval agreed before proceeding.

Related repair services

  • Grouping jobs into a clear repair list
  • Quote inclusions and business checks

property-manager-maintenance-coordinatio.beforeTitle: Rental Property Maintenance in Perth: A Repair Checklist
property-manager-maintenance-coordinatio.bodyHtml:
On-site assessment

This guide is for general reference only. Actual conditions vary. Contact Ellis Services Group to arrange an on-site assessment by the appropriate trade professional.

Build a Property Manager Repair List

Record the property address, affected room or exterior area, what the occupant has noticed, when it began and any continuing damage. Include previous related work where available. Photos are optional. If the occupant chooses to provide them, use only a stable, accessible position; they do not need to remove fittings, dismantle an item or investigate a hazard.

Keep wall holes, torn screens, cabinet faults and loose fittings as separate items. Group the mixed job list by location and priority. Ellis reviews the reported condition and explains the work and access needed. Keep diagnosis separate from the original report so the approved scope follows the site findings.

Use our Perth handyman and interior repair services for the work itself, and the home repair priorities guide to organise the request.

For a vacate list, identify torn flyscreen repairs, wall patching and small cabinet hardware repairs separately so each task can be assessed and authorised.

Prioritise Rental Maintenance Repairs & Vacate Jobs

Information to report and the next decision
Reported conditionProperty manager actionEllis work planning
An immediate hazard or loss of an essential serviceReport it promptly through the property's urgent contact process. Keep occupants clear of unsafe areas.Confirm the reported condition, access and authorised response before arranging the work.
Active or recurring damageIdentify whether water, movement or another issue is continuing. Escalate approval and record affected areas.Assess the cause and connected damage, then explain the repair sequence and any immediate protective measure.
Routine repair or improvementGroup items by room, desired outcome and available access. Mark owner priorities.Confirm the practical repair scope, materials and visit arrangements so approved tasks can be coordinated.

WA rental repair categories and deadlines guide the property manager's obligations; they are not an Ellis arrival or completion guarantee. Keep statutory reporting requirements and the confirmed booking arrangements distinct.

Rental Property Repairs: Assessment & Quote Approval

Assessment authorisation should identify the visit purpose, access, any agreed inspection fee and what findings are required. It does not automatically approve materials or repair work. Repair authorisation should identify the accepted scope, price or pricing basis, spending limit and person empowered to approve a change.

Add the owner's approval limit and escalation contact without sharing unrelated financial or tenant information. Where owner approval is needed, record it before confirming the repair. Our repair quote preparation guide helps you assemble the scope details.

Coordinate tenant access and changes

For strata, identify whether the work concerns a lot or common property and who can approve it. For offices or shops, include trading hours, noise limits and mounting locations alongside the access instructions.

Confirm who may authorise entry, the access window, keys or concierge arrangements, pets, alarms, parking and relevant site rules. Give the occupant the Ellis team member's identity when confirmed and one contact path for changes. A preferred window becomes an appointment once Ellis confirms it.

If the tenant reschedules, access is unavailable or the property manager's contact changes, update the job record and confirm a revised appointment with Ellis. Keep entry arrangements consistent with the property's tenancy requirements; a maintenance request is not permission to enter at any time.

Completion photos should focus on the repair, avoiding personal belongings wherever practical. Share only the job and access information needed for the work.

Confirm hidden damage and additional work

If inspection or opening an agreed work area reveals hidden damage, Ellis records what has changed and explains the required repair. A written variation should state the additional work, materials, cost basis and effect on scheduling. The property manager secures approval from the authorised decision-maker before additional work proceeds.

Where a protective response is needed, confirm exactly what action is authorised. Temporary measures and the full repair remain separate entries: record the protection provided, remaining restriction and the work still required. Do not mark the entire request complete because one area has been made safe.

Use one handover record through to completion

Keep the tenant report, inspection findings, accepted quote, owner approval, access confirmation and variations together. Close each task against the approved scope rather than treating a mixed list as one undifferentiated job.

  • Property address, job reference, requested task and authorising contact.
  • Approved repair scope, price basis, purchase-order reference and billing recipient.
  • Work completed, materials or components addressed and relevant completion photos.
  • Written variations, owner approvals and any items excluded or not yet completed.
  • Temporary measures, restrictions, monitoring and follow-up owner or occupant action.
  • Completion date, recipient of the handover and invoice checked against the approved work.

A completion record documents the agreed repairs; it is not a bond decision, statutory inspection or confirmation that concealed defects are absent. Tell the occupant and owner what was completed and what remains. Store the record securely so the next request starts with useful job history.

Property Maintenance Coordination: Common Questions

What should a property manager include first?

Include the property address, observed problem, priority, access contact, owner approval path and relevant job history. Safe existing photos and approximate measurements are optional.

Does assessment authorisation also authorise repairs?

No. Assessment authorisation covers the agreed inspection and any stated fee. Repair authorisation confirms the written work scope, price basis and spending limit before repairs begin.

What happens if Ellis finds hidden damage?

We record the finding and explain its effect on the repair scope. The property manager obtains the required owner approval for a written variation before additional work proceeds.

How are temporary measures recorded?

Record the measure taken, the area it protects, any remaining restrictions and the follow-up repair still required. A temporary measure does not close the original repair request.

Can one request cover a whole portfolio?

Yes. Use a separate record for each address, with its own tasks, access, approval limit and completion status. Agree portfolio arrangements with Ellis before booking.

Who receives the invoice and completion record?

Confirm the billing entity, purchase-order or job reference, approved scope, variations and recipient before booking. Match the invoice and handover record to those approvals.

Rental Maintenance & Vacate Repair Lists

Can a Perth handyman coordinate access with tenants?

Yes. Provide the authorised property contact and agreed access arrangements when booking. Ellis confirms the repair scope and quote with the person who can approve the work. Changes or additional repairs need approval; permission to enter is not approval for every task.

Can you quote for wall holes, torn flyscreens and a damaged cupboard before moving out?

Yes. List the affected items and confirm which repairs the landlord or property manager has authorised. We assess patching, screens and cabinet hardware as defined tasks and agree timing directly with you. Repair work does not determine whether your bond will be returned.

View Rental Maintenance & Vacate Repair Lists

Strata Minor Repairs, Office Repairs & Shop Fittings

Can a handyman carry out approved strata maintenance in Perth?

Ellis can assess approved strata maintenance after the authorised contact confirms the work and access. Specify whether the item is within a lot or on common property. Fire doors, electrical systems and other specialist components require the appropriate assessment, not a general repair assumption.

Can you assemble office desks and hang whiteboards outside trading hours?

Tell Ellis the products, quantities, mounting locations and preferred access window. We check the fixing surfaces and confirm the booking directly. Include parking, building access and the person who can approve work; after-hours access does not remove noise or building restrictions.

View Strata Minor Repairs, Office Repairs & Shop Fittings

seasonal-home-maintenance-australia.beforeTitle: Home Maintenance in Perth: A Seasonal Property Checklist
seasonal-home-maintenance-australia.bodyHtml:
Safe observations first

Use safe ground-level observations; an on-site assessment confirms the repair scope. Do not climb, dismantle equipment or disturb unidentified older material to complete this checklist.

Rainwater checks before and after wet weather

Record where gutters overflow, whether a downpipe or joint is affected and whether the same fault remains after cleaning. Blockage, fall, outlet capacity and damaged components require different responses. See gutter cleaning and repair for that assessment.

  • From safe ground, note overflowing sections and new damp marks.
  • Record the date, weather and any earlier cleaning or repairs.
  • Keep clear of damaged roofs, unstable trees and power lines; use appropriately equipped people for work at height.

The roofline and gutter example shows visible work details, not proof of a hidden drainage condition.

Exterior fittings, timber and surfaces

Check accessible screens, gates, fences, clotheslines and outdoor timber for changes. A dropping gate needs its supports checked; deck oil cannot repair weak boards. Loose brackets need more than retensioning. Avoid loading an unstable fitting.

  • Note torn flyscreens, moving fence or gate supports, and damaged deck boards.
  • For clotheslines, record the model and whether the line, bracket or arm is faulty. The Canning bracket repair shows one local repair.

Posts and wall fixings

Check for movement without digging or removing fixings. Underground services, boundaries and the supporting material must be considered before letterbox or hose-reel work.

Cleaning and material condition

Cleaning does not repair loose paving or a failed base. Fragile joints, coatings and runoff need checks; suspected asbestos must not be pressure cleaned. Read the surface-cleaning boundaries before arranging work.

The deck maintenance examples show separate settings. For soft timber, moving supports or unidentified eaves, use the structural and material safety guidance.

Indoor moisture, openings and fittings

Note doors or windows that now catch, damaged seals, condensation and recurring damp. Follow manufacturer maintenance instructions for heating and cooling equipment; electrical and gas work needs the appropriate authorised people. Never dismantle equipment for a seasonal check.

Floor edges and doorway trims

A lifting trim can be a trip hazard. Swollen boards near wet areas need the moisture source addressed before reinstatement. Click-lock and glued floors have different repair access; see local floor repairs.

Use the sticking door and window guide for movement faults, and carpentry for damaged skirting or trim.

Keep a practical seasonal repair list

  1. Write the date, room or outdoor location and observed change.
  2. Separate immediate hazards, active water damage, essential function and presentation work.
  3. Record known materials, previous repairs, access restrictions and who can approve work.
  4. Mark each item as observed, assessed, approved or completed; keep unresolved concerns on the list.
  5. Set the next review around local weather, property condition and material guidance, rather than a single national interval.

Existing safe photos are optional. For recurring visits or an owner overseas, use the property maintenance service and agree the local access contact and approval process.

Seasonal Maintenance Questions

Is there one maintenance calendar for all Australia?

No. Adjust timing for local weather, exposure, authority guidance and the property’s history.

Should I inspect my roof myself?

Use safe ground-level observations. Work at height or on a damaged roof should be left to appropriately equipped Ellis Perth team members.

Can Ellis schedule seasonal work everywhere?

Contact Ellis with your Perth suburb, postcode and maintenance details. Our team confirms the local service arrangements, site assessment and quote.

shower-silicone-grout-waterproofing-guid.beforeTitle: Shower Resealing in Perth: Silicone, Grout or Waterproofing?
shower-silicone-grout-waterproofing-guid.bodyHtml:
Before attempting repairs

This guide helps you describe a fault and plan an assessment. It does not diagnose your property or replace task-specific safety and trade requirements.

Split shower silicone and surface joints

Silicone is commonly used at movement joints and changes of plane in a tiled wet area. A split or deteriorated joint may need surface resealing, but its appearance does not establish the condition of the system behind the tiles. Describe staining, gaps and whether the shower leaks during use. New silicone should not be presented as a guaranteed cure for a leak whose source has not been identified.

Missing tile grout and loose tiles

Grout fills joints between tiles, while the underlying waterproofing is a separate part of the construction. Missing grout, loose tiles or recurring cracking may need more investigation than refilling visible gaps. Note whether tiles have moved and whether damp appears outside the shower. Tell Ellis about previous regrouting or resealing and whether it changed the symptoms. Movement and backing condition affect the appropriate work.

Failed shower waterproofing and adjoining-room damp

Water appearing in a bedroom or below a tiled balcony may come from several sources. Plumbing, drainage, surface joints and the underlying wet-area system should be considered during assessment. Where deeper failure is identified, investigation and repairs may involve tile removal, substrate work, waterproofing and retiling. Those are distinct from surface maintenance and need an agreed scope; the visible stain alone cannot determine the complete repair.

What to ask before accepting a shower repair quote

Explain where water appears, when it happens and which repairs have already been attempted. Ask what has been assessed, what remains unknown and which surface or underlying work is included. Confirm how additional damage will be reported and approved. For apartments, include affected neighbouring areas and access arrangements. Avoid treating a maintenance quote as proof that every concealed component is sound.

Common Repair Questions

What is the difference between grout and silicone?

Grout and silicone serve different joint requirements in a tiled finish. Neither is a substitute for assessing the waterproofing beneath the tiles. The appropriate material and repair depend on the joint and condition.

How is resealing different from waterproofing a shower?

Resealing addresses specified surface joints. Waterproofing repairs address the underlying wet-area system and may involve removing and reinstating finishes. The required work follows assessment of the leak.

Why does a shower still leak after new silicone?

The leak may involve another joint, plumbing, movement or the underlying waterproofing. Report what was resealed and where damp persists. Repeating the same surface treatment without assessment may leave the cause unresolved.

Split Shower Silicone & Missing Tile Grout

Can replacing shower silicone fix every shower leak?

No. Replacing silicone only addresses the surface joint included in the work. A leaking shower may also have failed waterproofing, plumbing faults or movement beneath the tiles. Ellis assesses the symptoms before quoting resealing, regrouting or further investigation.

Can you assess black silicone around the shower base?

Yes. Explain whether there is staining only, split joints, loose tiles or damp in an adjoining room. We check the joint condition and signs of water entry before agreeing the surface repair. New silicone should not be offered as a guaranteed cure for an unidentified leak.

View Split Shower Silicone & Missing Tile Grout

Cracked Floor Tiles & Loose Tile Repairs

Can just one cracked floor tile be replaced?

A local replacement may be possible where a suitable tile is available and the surrounding floor is sound. Ellis checks why it cracked and the supporting surface before quoting. Recurring cracks, movement or moisture should be investigated instead of repeatedly replacing a tile.

Can you assess a loose splashback tile behind the sink?

Yes. Tell us whether the tile has moved, grout is missing or the wall is damp. We inspect the tile and backing before agreeing a local repair. Leaking plumbing or damaged backing must be considered separately from the visible tile finish.

View Cracked Floor Tiles & Loose Tile Repairs

Failed Shower Waterproofing & Balcony Leak Assessment

When does a shower repair need tiles removed and waterproofing redone?

Tile removal and waterproofing repairs may be needed where assessment identifies failure beneath the surface. New silicone cannot establish that the underlying membrane is sound. Ellis confirms the investigation, repair sequence and scope before quoting the work.

Can you assess a shower leaking into the adjoining bedroom?

Yes. Describe where damp appears, when it occurs and whether previous resealing helped. The assessment considers plumbing, joints and the tiled wet-area system. Surface resealing, waterproofing and retiling are distinct works; the cause should be established before choosing the repair.

View Failed Shower Waterproofing & Balcony Leak Assessment

sticking-doors-windows-repair-guide.beforeTitle: Door & Timber Window Repairs in Perth: Sticking or Dragging?
sticking-doors-windows-repair-guide.bodyHtml:
Before attempting repairs

This guide helps you describe a fault and plan an assessment. It does not diagnose your property or replace task-specific safety and trade requirements.

Sticking internal doors and hinge adjustment

A door that rubs after new carpet needs a different assessment from one that has dropped on loose hinges. Record where contact occurs, whether the latch lines up and what recently changed. The frame, hinges, door construction and floor clearance all affect the proposed repair. Do not assume trimming is appropriate for every door. Security and fire-rated components have specific requirements that must be checked before modification.

Timber windows swelling after wet weather

If a window becomes difficult to close after rain, describe the timing and any visible damp, cracked finish or soft timber. Moisture entry may affect the sill, frame or surrounding materials. Planing or repainting without assessing the cause may leave the same fault recurring. Hardware, sash movement and glazing can involve different repair scopes. Do not force a swollen or unstable window simply to make it shut.

Sliding doors hard to open: rollers, track and alignment

Dragging can come from worn rollers, track damage, debris or misalignment. Identify whether the affected panel is glass or an insect screen and whether it has left its track. Roller replacement does not necessarily require replacing the whole door, but compatible hardware and a serviceable track matter. Heavy glass and mirrored panels require appropriate handling. Keep clear of unstable panels rather than lifting or forcing them yourself.

Repair, replacement and access details

Tell Ellis the door or window type, the symptoms, how long the fault has been present and what you want retained. Existing photos are useful but not required. Include apartment lifts, parking, building access and the person authorised to approve work. A written quote should distinguish adjustments, replacement hardware, timber work, glazing and finishing. Repeated moisture or movement needs to be considered before choosing a cosmetic repair.

Common Repair Questions

Why does a timber door stick in wet weather?

Moisture can affect timber and its finish, but hinge or frame problems may also be involved. Note when it sticks and where it rubs. Assessment should consider the cause before trimming or repainting.

Does a damaged sliding-door track always need replacement?

Not always. The extent of damage, panel alignment and available compatible components determine whether local repair or replacement is appropriate. Roller work alone may not correct a damaged track.

Should I call a handyman, carpenter or glazier for a window repair?

Describe the fault rather than choosing a trade from the window name alone. Timber, hardware and glass can need different capabilities. Ellis confirms the appropriate work after reviewing the issue.

Sticking Internal Doors & Door Hinge Adjustment

Who can fix a door that will not close in Perth?

Ellis can inspect a door that will not close and assess the hinges, latch, frame and clearance. Tell us whether it rubs, drops or misses the latch. A local adjustment and installing a new door are different scopes; the inspection determines which is appropriate.

Can you assess a bedroom door rubbing after new carpet?

Yes. Mention the flooring change and show where the door catches. We check the clearance, hinges and door construction before proposing an adjustment. Fire-rated and security doors need their specific requirements checked; they are not treated as ordinary internal doors.

View Sticking Internal Doors & Door Hinge Adjustment

Sliding Doors Hard to Open & Worn Rollers

Can sliding door rollers be replaced without replacing the door?

Often the rollers can be assessed separately from the door, but the track, frame and matching hardware also matter. Ellis checks what has worn and whether the panel is suitable to retain. Heavy glass panels require an appropriate handling method, not force to release a jammed door.

My apartment balcony door is jammed. What should I tell Ellis?

Tell us whether the glass panel or insect screen is stuck, whether it can close securely and if it has left the track. Include apartment access and building approval requirements. Keep clear of an unstable panel and arrange an assessment before trying to lift it.

View Sliding Doors Hard to Open & Worn Rollers

Sticking Timber Windows & Damaged Window Sills

Who can repair an old timber window in Perth?

Ellis assesses old timber windows, including the frame, sill, moving parts and hardware. Explain whether the window sticks, leaks or no longer closes securely. Local timber and hardware repairs are considered alongside any glazing or more extensive replacement work required.

My timber window swells after rain. Can you assess the cause?

Yes. Describe when it sticks, where water appears and whether the sill feels soft. The assessment considers moisture entry as well as the moving parts. Repeatedly trimming or repainting the window without addressing moisture may not resolve the recurring fault.

View Sticking Timber Windows & Damaged Window Sills

Pet Flaps in Timber Doors & Ordinary Flyscreens

Can a pet door be fitted into an existing timber door?

Ellis assesses the door material, panel construction and product before fitting a pet door. Tell us the pet size and proposed position. Glass, security screens and fire-rated doors require their specific requirements to be checked, rather than treated as a standard timber cut-out.

Can you replace a cat flap in an ordinary flyscreen?

Yes, subject to the screen condition and a suitable product. We check the opening, frame and mesh support before confirming fitting. Explain if the screen is also a security door so its safety and security requirements can be assessed separately.

View Pet Flaps in Timber Doors & Ordinary Flyscreens

Can you install a pet door in glass or a security screen?

Ellis checks the panel type and safety or security requirements before agreeing the installation. Some glass installations need a purpose-made replacement pane. We confirm the appropriate installation method, components and price before work begins.

Can a pet door be cut into an existing toughened pane?

Do not drill or cut an existing toughened-glass pane. We assess the opening and pet-door product, then confirm whether a purpose-made replacement pane is needed.

Could a pet door affect a security door?

Yes. The alteration can affect the complete security product. Ellis checks the product and applicable work requirements before agreeing any change. Do not assume fitting a pet flap preserves the door’s security performance.

If the problem is a dragging patio slider, damaged track or worn roller, our sliding door repair service explains the repair options, compatible parts and panel-handling assessment. Tell Ellis which panel is affected; photos are optional.

For hinges, latch alignment and a rubbing hinged door, see door repairs. Tell Ellis where it catches and whether flooring or earlier repairs changed the clearance. Patio glass sliders need their own roller and track assessment.

Related repair decisions

Choose a pet flap for the actual panel

Pet-door installation can be assessed for a suitable timber door or ordinary insect-screen panel. Dog doors and cat flaps need a compatible product, opening size and supporting door construction; a pet flap is not a universal cut-out task.

A supplied pet flap must suit the panel thickness and construction. Glass and security doors need their own assessment before a product is selected. Ellis agrees supply, fitting, making good and removal separately after checking the proposed opening.

A small dog door in a laundry timber door and a replacement cat flap in an ordinary flyscreen need different support checks. Tell Ellis the pet size, product and panel type; confirm property permission before any alteration.

wall-patching-paint-touch-ups-guide.beforeTitle: Wall Patching in Perth: Gyprock Repairs & Paint Touch-ups
wall-patching-paint-touch-ups-guide.bodyHtml:
Before attempting repairs

This guide helps you describe a fault and plan an assessment. It does not diagnose your property or replace task-specific safety and trade requirements.

Plasterboard hole repairs and backing condition

A door-handle hole or damage after removing a TV bracket can affect the board face, backing or a larger area than the visible opening. Record the number and approximate size of damaged areas. The repair method depends on the surrounding board and support, not only the hole diameter. Avoid opening walls to investigate concealed services yourself. On older or unidentified materials, the material should be assessed before cutting or sanding.

Why wall patches show through paint

A patched area can differ in texture, absorption, flatness or sheen from the surrounding surface. Paint colour is only one part of the finish. Preparation and finishing over a larger area may be needed for a consistent appearance. Ask whether the quote covers patching alone, preparation, priming and a local touch-up, or repainting the wall. This avoids assuming a small patch includes an invisible match across aged paint.

Scuffed wall touch-ups and aged paint

Keep existing paint details if available, including colour and sheen. A fresh coating can look different where the old finish has faded, worn or been cleaned unevenly. Small touch-ups and full-wall repainting have different material and labour requirements. Explain the result you expect, particularly before rental handover or photography. The assessment should establish a realistic finish rather than guarantee that every repair will be invisible.

Moisture, ceiling cracks and recurring damage

A stained ceiling or recurring crack is not automatically a cosmetic patching task. Report active leaks, movement, sagging and previous repairs before agreeing a finish. The cause and condition need assessment before damaged surfaces are closed or painted. Keep clear of an unstable ceiling. If a leak has been repaired, tell Ellis when it was fixed so the affected materials can be checked before finishing is planned.

Common Repair Questions

What is the difference between plaster and plasterboard repairs?

The materials and supporting construction differ, so preparation and patching are not interchangeable. Describe the damage and let the assessment identify the surface rather than assuming all walls need the same patch.

Why does touch-up paint look different from the rest of the wall?

Colour, sheen, age, texture and preparation can all affect the appearance. Matching a colour name alone does not guarantee a match. Discuss whether a larger finishing area is appropriate.

Should a water-damaged ceiling be dry before repair?

The water source and material condition should be assessed before patching and finishing. Active leaks, weakened board or sagging need attention; painting over a stain does not resolve the underlying problem.

Plasterboard Hole Repairs & Damaged Ceiling Cornices

How much does it cost to patch a hole in a wall in Perth?

The price depends on the hole size, board condition, access and required finish. Ellis assesses the damage and quotes the patching and any agreed painting separately in the scope. Matching an old painted surface may require finishing beyond the patch itself.

Can you repair wall damage after a TV bracket is removed?

Yes. Tell us how many fixing holes remain and whether the plasterboard face is torn or loose. We assess backing, patching and the finish required. If you want repainting included, identify the wall area and any existing paint details before approving the quote.

View Plasterboard Hole Repairs & Damaged Ceiling Cornices

Scuffed Wall Touch-ups & Door Trim Repainting

Can a handyman touch up paint after a wall repair?

Ellis can assess painting required after a wall repair and confirm preparation, colour, sheen and the area to finish. A small touch-up may still show against aged paint. We explain whether finishing a larger area would give a more consistent result before you approve the work.

Can you match paint on a rental wall patch?

We assess the existing colour, sheen and surface, using paint details if available. Colour matching alone does not guarantee an invisible patch on weathered or aged paint. Confirm the approved area and required result with your property manager before arranging the finish.

View Scuffed Wall Touch-ups & Door Trim Repainting

when-home-maintenance-needs-a-licensed-t.beforeTitle: When Do Perth Home Repairs Need a Licensed Trade?
when-home-maintenance-needs-a-licensed-t.bodyHtml:
Scope note

This guide is for general reference only. Actual conditions vary. Contact Ellis Services Group to arrange an on-site assessment by the appropriate trade professional.

The task matters more than the label

The exact work determines the required capability. Separate a TV bracket from a new power point, a cupboard repair from a leaking sink, and surface resealing from concealed wet-area repairs. Fire doors, security components, structural repairs and suspected asbestos also need their specific requirements checked.

For a grab rail, the product, position and supporting wall matter; a towel rail is not a substitute. Ordinary maintenance is not automatically a funded home modification. Confirm funding, plan approval and any required installation documents separately before agreeing work.

Keep people clear of exposed wiring, gas smells, active water near electrical fittings, structural movement or suspected hazardous material. Seek the appropriate emergency service, utility or authorised advice for immediate danger. Do not investigate physically or ask anyone to work beyond their authorised scope.

Check the correct credential for the work

We confirm the personnel, credentials and project documents relevant to your electrical, plumbing, gas or building work before it begins.

An ABN identifies a business; it does not replace a trade licence. Ellis discusses the credentials and project documents relevant to the agreed work before it begins.

How Ellis Delivers Licensed Work

Contact Ellis Perth with the property location and observed problem. Photos and measurements are optional. We arrange the on-site assessment and confirm who will attend, the visit purpose and access.

Our own appropriately licensed personnel complete regulated work within the agreed scope. Discuss electrical work and plumbing repairs as separate tasks from ordinary handyman work, even when they share one request.

Before repairs start, confirm the written scope, quote and relevant credentials or documents. If the findings introduce regulated work or change the agreed repair, pause the affected task and approve the revised scope and price in writing.

Licensed Trade Requirements: Common Questions

Is every handyman task licensed?

No. Requirements depend on the task, value, location and other factors. Check the relevant state or territory regulator.

Does an ABN prove a trade licence?

No. Business registration and trade licensing are different checks.

How do I confirm the right licence for work by Ellis?

Ask Ellis to identify the attending personnel and credentials for the agreed task. Our own appropriately licensed personnel complete regulated work. Check the relevant credential through the official regulator before work starts.

Home Safety Maintenance & Grab Rail Fixing Assessment

Can I arrange handyman repairs for an elderly parent in Perth?

Yes. A family member can arrange a household repair enquiry, nominate the person who approves work and discuss suitable access with Ellis. For grab rails, supply an existing placement plan if available. Funding eligibility and approval are separate from our assessment of the repair.

Can you assess a loose handrail at the front steps?

Yes. Explain where it moves and whether it is needed for support. Avoid relying on an unstable rail. We assess the rail, supporting material and fixing requirements before agreeing repairs; a towel rail or improvised fitting is not a suitable substitute.

View Home Safety Maintenance & Grab Rail Fixing Assessment

TV Bracket Fitting & Separate Electrical Work

Can a handyman replace a power point in Perth?

A power point replacement is electrical work, separate from TV bracket fitting. Tell Ellis what needs changing so we can confirm the electrical work, applicable licensing requirements and quote before work starts.

Does TV bracket fitting include a new power point?

No. Bracket fitting and installing or changing a power point are distinct scopes. Tell Ellis both requirements so the electrical work is assessed and quoted appropriately. Do not alter fixed wiring or ask for it to be treated as a simple wall-mounting task.

View TV Bracket Fitting & Separate Electrical Work

What should I confirm before requesting an NDIS-funded home repair?

Confirm funding eligibility, invoicing, registration requirements and approval with your plan contact before booking. Then share the approved repair list and any installation plan with Ellis. We confirm the work and access directly; funding approval is a separate step from the property assessment.

When do pergola repairs require structural advice?

Sagging, movement, damaged supports or connections and changes to roof loads need more than a trim repair. Keep clear of unstable areas. Ellis scopes the appropriate assessment before agreeing repair work.

Could older eaves lining contain asbestos?

Yes. Leave unidentified lining undisturbed and tell us where the repair is needed. We arrange assessment before work; do not cut, drill, sand or pressure clean suspect material.

Which older materials should not be pressure cleaned?

Keep suspected asbestos and unidentified materials undisturbed. We check paving, coatings and joints before choosing a cleaning method. Patio and paving cleaning does not include roof or asbestos cleaning.

Is handyman maintenance the same as a funded home modification?

No. Tell us the repair or modification you need. We confirm the work and quote with you; please confirm any funding approval and payment arrangements before booking.

Why are grab-rail placement and fixings assessed first?

The location must suit the intended use and appropriate plan; the wall must support the chosen product and fixings. Ellis checks both before installation. A visually solid wall finish is insufficient, and installation alone is not an accessibility assessment.

Can a bathroom towel rail serve as a support rail?

Do not rely on it for balance or transfer support. A suitable grab rail needs its own product, placement and structural fixing assessment. Tell Ellis the intended use and bring any adviser’s plan before installation is agreed.

Describe a maintenance request →

TV mounting and electrical changes

A bracket installation starts with the television, wall and fixing checks. Our TV wall mounting service distinguishes mounting and cable placement from new power points or fixed wiring, which Ellis's own appropriately licensed personnel complete within the separately agreed electrical scope.

Related repair decisions

Patio trim, supports and unidentified eaves lining

Suitable minor patio, pergola and eaves repairs start with the damaged component and material identified. Loose trim differs from a failing beam, post, roof connection or unidentified old lining.

Ellis assesses support, moisture history and material before agreeing local work. Structural movement and suspected hazardous material need the appropriate own-team assessment and controls before disturbance; a small visible area does not establish a small-risk repair.

Weathered trim under a patio and damaged eaves sheet on an older house need different checks. Keep clear of loose overhead material. Do not remove, sand or drill unidentified lining to prepare photos; existing safely taken photos are optional.

Repairs for older residents and support-rail enquiries

You can arrange suitable small household repairs for an older family member. Identify who approves the work, who will be present and any communication or access needs. A loose handrail needs its support assessed before anyone relies on it.

We check the grab rail, wall support and installation position. Tell us your installation requirements and confirm any funding approval and payment arrangements before booking.

For a loose front-step handrail or household fittings needing repair for an older resident, describe the risk and keep the unstable fitting out of use. Bring any adviser’s rail plan; location advice and installation are separate assessments, without an accessibility guarantee.
